title: Bulk nano-CUT&Tag Nextflow pipeline parameters
description: Validated inputs and analysis settings for the manifest-driven bulk nano-CUT&Tag workflow.

input.description: CSV manifest with one row per barcode-derived sample.

fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA used to build a Bowtie2 index when --bowtie2_index is omitted.

bowtie2_index.description: Optional Bowtie2 index prefix; takes precedence over building an index from --fasta.

blacklist.description: Optional BED blacklist removed from final broad peaks and motif inputs.

gtf.description: Optional GTF used to derive strand-aware transcription start sites.

tss_bed.description: Optional precomputed strand-aware TSS BED, used instead of --gtf.

motif_db.description: Optional MEME-format motif database enabling motif analysis.

chipseq_input.description: Optional CSV manifest of external ChIP-seq reference peak sets used for peak-enrichment comparisons.

barcode_mismatches.description: Maximum I2 barcode Hamming distance; it must be less than the manifest barcode length.

allow_empty.description: Permit zero-read derived samples for diagnostic runs.

min_mapq.description: Minimum MAPQ for filtered BAM, coverage, and fragment-based QC.

macs_genome_size.description: Required MACS2 genome size shortcut (for example hs) or effective genome-size integer.

macs_llocal.description: MACS2 local lambda window for NanoScope-compatible peak calls.

macs_keep_dup.description: MACS2 duplicate retention setting for NanoScope-compatible peak calls.

macs_max_gap.description: Maximum gap for MACS2 broad-peak merging.

motif_use_narrow_peaks.description: Use optional controlled narrow-peak summits for motif QC; broad peaks remain the primary result.

motif_window.description: Total width in base pairs of the reference-bounded motif sequence window.

enrichment_permutations.description: Number of null permutations requested per foreground/reference/background-model enrichment comparison.

enrichment_seed.description: Deterministic seed for optional peak-enrichment comparisons.

enrichment_gc_tolerance.description: Maximum absolute GC-fraction delta allowed for GC-matched enrichment background sampling.
